The '''captain''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ031|Song Within the Mist]]''. He is a sailor, alongside other crew members who witnessed a {{p|Lapras}} beautiful song, which wanders around itself surrounded by [[Lapras Sea|mist]]. Afterwards, he told the information to [[Friede]].
